items.overview: After the death of their old college roommate who they haven't spoken to in years, Matt and Milo go to his funeral. Things grow intense as they are expected to give the eulogy.
items.title: Wilting Flowers

items.overview: Experimental narrative documentary on a fly who gets trapped beside an open window.  Dead Flies is a film about... a dead fly.
items.title: Dead Flies

items.overview: Two detectives race against time to interrogate a local mechanic, suspicious that he might be a notorious serial killer
items.title: Calling Card

items.overview: What does it mean to be a kid? A group of young snowboarders - Camille Armand, Enzo Scotto, and Quentin Ladame - set out to explore this question in the heart of the Japanese winter, where deep snow transforms the landscape into a endless playground.
items.title: Kids

items.original_title: Pure Elegance Tour: Live at History
items.overview: In this live concert film, Ninja Sex Party brings you the most tasteful and opulent experience known to humankind, a show full of genteel music addressing some of life's deepest mysteries: What does it feel like to own a car? To take a date to your parents' house? Or to board a spaceship to save a sexless future? Watch, and the answers shall reveal themselves to you forthwith!
items.title: Pure Elegance Tour: Live at History

items.overview: When three disillusioned friends stumble upon a religious commune, one of them embarks on a mission to discover the truth about the group's mysterious leader before it is too late...
items.title: Kingdom of Dust

items.overview: Influencer Chiara Ferragni opens up for the first time on the charity scandal that rocked her career and sparked the end of her high-profile marriage.
items.title: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing

items.overview: Exploring the influence of 1960s spy mania on the latter Supermarionation series, from Thunderbirds to The Secret Service.
items.title: The Last Spy-fi Series

items.overview: TV historian Matthew Sweet goes in search of the people, places and puppets that brought The Secret Service to life.
items.title: The Secret Service Revisited

items.overview: A hunting initiation rite ends in a dark pact of silence when a stray shot awakens a cursed legacy in the deep, secluded heart of the forest.
items.title: Paganos

items.overview: After years of infertility, Rocío takes in a street child as if he were her own son. Her obsession with motherhood triggers a domestic thriller that draws León into a world of marginalized children, secrets, and captivity.
items.title: Hijos

items.overview: Following the loss of his partner, David wanders the city, heartbroken and lost. By chance, he comes across an occult shop and decides to step inside for a tarot reading. After laying out the cards, the tarot reader hands him a piece of paper containing a set of instructions: perform a ritual and visit the cemetery at nightfall. As David arrives at the cemetery, overwhelmed by despair, he encounters a spectral presence that brings him comfort.
items.title: Beyond the beyond

items.overview: In the future, emotions and gestures have disappeared. But we are in the present: five researchers arrive on electric scooters in a village in the Basque Country, searching for what their time has forgotten. Through interviews and observation, they enter the intimacy of its inhabitants, until the boundaries between the different times begin to blur.
items.title: Bitartean, gero

items.overview: Mona lives alone in a working-class neighborhood. A sex worker and private party organizer, she leads a discreet life, far from prying eyes. One evening, on returning home after a night of heavy drinking, she finds a young man—not yet twenty—in a balaclava breaking into her apartment, while other hooded youths wreak havoc in the street outside, destroying and setting fire to everything in their path. Who is this young man? What does he want from her? Confronted by this mysterious intruder, Mona must face the secrets of her past as they suddenly resurface.
items.title: Hoods

items.original_title: រោងចក្រទឹកកក
items.overview: Khmer movie
items.title: Ice Factory Ghost

items.overview: A dark psychological thriller revolving around a mysterious killer, a series of unsettling events, and a story of revenge.
items.title: Revenge of Her : Evil Prevails

items.overview: We retrace the path that was used by the women who walked up to the penitentiary of Fort San Cristóbal to help political prisoners between 1934 and 1945, as Spain went through Republic, Civil War, and Franco’s dictatorship. We search for their footprints, listen to their voices. The earth remembers.
items.title: If the Birds Sing

items.overview: Wilson trapped in a suffocating labyrinth of solipsism and modern burnout. Over one sleepless night he searches for something with no name, until a black star appears: a repeating light, an immovable loss, bright and black at the same time.
items.title: BLACK STAR

items.overview: A group of strangers coming from different countries accepts a very exciting invite for Christmas. As they arrive at the location, they soon discover what are the real plans of the mastermind behind the whole thing.
items.title: Jingle Hell

items.overview: From the World Championships to the Diagonale des Fous and the UTMB, Blandine L’Hirondel takes us on a journey through the legendary races of ultra-trail running. This lively and sincere portrait explores her daily challenges: balancing her career as a gynecologist with the demands of elite-level competition, overcoming setbacks, and pushing herself to the limit.
items.title: Blandine

items.overview: An ayu sweetfish mutates into a giant monster, dubbed Ayura, and attacks the Gifu prefecture of Japan. Kaoru, an unassuming government worker, is suddenly tasked to pilot the giant robot "Meka-U" as an emergency effort to stop Ayura.
items.title: Ayura

items.overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.
items.title: Mustang

items.overview: follows a man who returns to a family farm inherited from his parents, only to uncover a terrifying truth that threatens his survival there. The film explores how family bonds between parents and children can become a source of both salvation and control.
items.title: Soulala

items.overview: Every winter, millions of fir trees are chopped down, admired, and thrown away. The film follows their journey above and below ground, from human rituals to the hidden life inside the trees. A story about trees that we celebrate by cutting them down.
items.title: Holy Wood Dust

items.overview: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.
items.title: Clashing Through the Snow

items.overview: An animated adventure about Jojo the Axolotl, taking on the world to find his family, set in a fantastically inspired Mexican lakeside.
items.title: Axolodyssey

items.overview: This film exposes the hidden dangers of dating apps driven by the urgent consumption of sex and entertainment. Behind simple profile pictures often hide pathological narcissists and ambiguous characters. Looking for fleeting encounters, they prey on vulnerable users through flattery and deception.  In this virtual world, emotional connection is entirely absent. Everyone becomes a mere object of desire in a perverse, addictive game of dominance and submission that detaches users from reality. Ultimately, the virtual realm takes over, leading to a profound depersonalization where human beings are completely stripped of their humanity.
items.title: The Other You

items.overview: Hassan struggles to make a living as a fisherman in a small coastal town, where the sea provides less each year. Isolated by his faith, his only moments of tenderness are with single mother Latifah and her young daughter. When an old friend offers a dangerous alternative, Hassan becomes trapped between judgement and action.
items.title: Waves of Silence

items.overview: Portrait of Mayan midwives who do ultrasounds with their hands, those who respect the nature of the living and that contrast with the modern world.
items.title: Sinahal, The Mayan Midwives

items.overview: The dramatic stories of Iranians living through a year of protests, crackdowns and war. Rare footage and firsthand accounts of the regime's campaign to crush dissent, and of life under U.S. and Israeli bombing.
items.title: Iranians Under Siege

items.original_title: An Angel Messed Up My Christmas
items.overview: When an angel sends Elliot back to high school during Christmas, changing one thing creates a future without the family he loves. Now he must undo his mistakes to save them, and rediscover what made his life perfect all along.
items.title: An Angel Messed Up My Christmas

items.overview: In a world where a deadly virus has made the night air fatal, a secret platform allows people to hire strangers to fulfill their darkest desires.
items.title: The Black Sea

items.overview: In a remote Georgian village surrounded by misty mountains, a local man discovers the body of a young stranger on the riverbank and takes him home to his wife and young son. The arrival of this unexpected guest disturbs the family’s already fragile life, forcing each member to make difficult and extreme decisions.
items.title: Tago

items.overview: Nate Bargatze brings his dry wit and deadpan charm to overzealous parking sensors, the walking politics of marriage and an unhinged family group chat.
items.title: Nate Bargatze: Good for Nathan

items.overview: A quiet get-together among friends ends in a bloody massacre when one of them has the audacity to break a sacred rule of Argentine tradition: the yerba in the mate is never stirred. Never. Ever.
items.title: Mate The 13th

items.overview: Lucía, Juana, and Evaristo work in a city that functions like an open-air factory. Meanwhile, Sami and Claudio work aboard an Argentine space capsule. Following the recent arrival of new owners in the country, Lucía confronts this new order by painting counter-advertisements on city walls. At the same time, Sami tries to return to Earth by any means necessary, after being informed that no one will be coming to look for them.
items.title: O

items.original_title: Memórias de um Assassino de Tigres
items.overview: After being fired from his job, the conformist Aderbal loses all of his unemployment insurance to online betting sites. Devastated by his loss, he embarks on a journey of revenge, vowing to murder every influencer he encounters who promotes gambling websites. Meanwhile, a nuclear conflict between Brazil and the United States threatens all life on Earth.
items.title: Memoirs of a Tiger Killer

items.overview: A mother who is a painter, haunted by the violence of her past, sees her reality begin to crumble after her son returns. As distorted memories and reality blur together, she sinks deeper into a psychological struggle against a trauma that refuses to let her go.
items.title: L’éclat

items.overview: Jax is about to jump off a bridge onto the highway below when he unexpectedly runs into Joy, his childhood friend. Joy tries to calm him down and asks him to stay by his side wherever they go. This unexpected reunion brings them closer again as they spend the entire day together, slowly rekindling their bond.
items.title: Lorazepam

items.overview: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.
items.title: Rob Lowe: The Outsider

items.overview: One dark October evening, 25-year-old Liselotte gets into a car in Timrå. After that, all signs of life cease. Ten days later, she is found dead next to a cliff ledge.
items.title: GW:s mord - Mordet på Liselotte

items.overview: A fictional boy aims to become a non-fictional rapper. His label has other plans.
items.title: SO ALIVE!

items.overview: A collection of portraits from Drobeta-Turnu Severin and its surroundings.
items.title: Fabrica

items.overview: Richie is a man struggling with his inner demons as he faces the effects of substance abuse on both his relationships and mental well-being.
items.title: Sessions

items.overview: On the shore of an island he once imagined, Cassius recalls Sami, his first love and a former tecktonik dancer.
items.title: La Pointe de mon île

items.overview: After tin mining in Singkep ended, Lunar imagines its past grandeur through her mother’s stories. When a mysterious Tin Man appears across fragmented time, merely photographing the present, the film interrogates memory, extraction, and the lingering socio-ecological afterlife of a mined city.
items.title: Portrait of Tin's Family

items.overview: In this enchanting third story in the Home Sweet Christmas franchise, Sophie and Sam embark to celebrate their first anniversary in picturesque Salzburg, a sprawling Christmas postcard town adorned with decorations and lights, a place one can almost smell the scents of mulled wine and gingerbread. What begins as a romantic first-year getaway quickly transforms into a lavish royal mystery when a charismatic hotelier draws the couple into a world of festive surprises. As Sophie uncovers a hidden connection to a beloved Christmas song, she and Sam must navigate the host’s surprising twists to safeguard their love – and to rediscover the true spirit of Christmas.
items.title: A Sweet Christmas Anniversary

items.overview: Follow the unfolding of a catastrophic blizzard that swiftly buried the city of Buffalo in snow and darkness, cutting power, heat, and visibility to residents trapped at home and on roads. A McDonald’s manager breaks protocol to create an impromptu refuge, people instantly mobilize to rescue their neighbors, and a community comes together in the most unexpected Christmas Eve celebration.
items.title: The Buffalo Miracle

items.overview: Bilbao, 1983. Torrential rains cause the river to overflow, flooding the city and plunging it into chaos. Meanwhile, the gay club High remains open, operating intermittently through power cuts as some men continue to come, suspended in a limbo of desire. Little by little, the outside world seeps in: rising water and distant sounds reveal an internal reality from which there is no easy escape.
items.title: High River

items.overview: When Maine wakes up in the middle of the night after a first date, his lover’s house is full of unsettling surprises about who he truly is.
items.title: Lustlings

items.overview: The French-Moroccan Alaoui family is preparing for a holiday reunion in their Marrakech home, eagerly awaiting the arrival of their daughter and sister, Leila. Their fragile balance is shattered when they learn she has been seriously injured while on assignment as a photographer in Burkina Faso. Cut off from her yet determined to bring her home, they struggle against the void her absence threatens to leave behind.
items.title: Leila et la Nuit

items.overview: Podcaster Winona is forced to test love online by a holiday dating-app partnership, connecting with a mystery man who feels like everything she’s been missing. What she doesn’t know is that he’s Luke, the rugged renovator transforming her grandmother’s Christmas Eve venue — and the last guy she’d ever expect to fall for in real life.
items.title: All for Christmas

items.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.
items.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH

items.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.
items.title: Way of the Warrior Kid

items.original_title: Robert Wilson – Die Schönheit des Geheimnisvollen
items.overview: We look back at more than half a century of mysterious artistic creation while trying to crack a unique artistic code. Why are people moved to tears when Robert “Bob” Wilson puts minimalistic petrol pumps into a production of Shakespeare’s sonnets? Why does merciless repetition change our understanding of something? Together with Tom Waits, Willem Dafoe or Marina Abramović we trace back our own experience of Bob’s art. Is it true what Philipp Glass the collaborator of the milestone piece “Einstein on the Beach” laughingly and with apparent pleasure exclaims “what does it mean? It doesn’t mean anything!”?
items.title: Robert Wilson: The Beauty of the Mysterious

items.overview: Tom is 6 years old. With his camera, he films his mother, the dog, and the alley. Tom has difficulties with studying; he is hyperactive; he has anger issues at school; moreover, he eats crisps for supper. Tom is the son of Nathalie, a loving drug-addicted bipolar mother; the brother of Caroline, an escort who would like to go back to school; and the grandson of Madeleine, the grandmother tired of taking care of everyone. Petit Tom is a film about life and childhood in the setting of chaos, flowing time, family heritage, and motherly love.
items.title: Petit Tom

items.overview: A young boy struggles to put his knowledge to good use. As he faces the choices before him, he must decide whether to use his abilities wisely or let his potential go to waste.
items.title: Acedia

items.overview: Under the ruthless rule of the mighty and evil EL OSO, four subjects secretly plot their revenge, scheming to overthrow the existing regime and seize power for themselves...
items.title: EL OSO

items.overview: The story of Monte Melkonian , National Hero of Armenia, Hero of Artsakh and one of the commanders of the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. Based entirely on real events confirmed by Monte’s widow, Seta Melkonian.
items.title: Monte

items.original_title: Alain Souchon accompagné par Ours & Pierre Souchon
items.title: Alain Souchon accompagné par Ours & Pierre Souchon

items.overview: In a vast darkness, a girl tries to find her way using the only light she can find, one coveted by others.
items.title: Starlight

items.overview: When tragedy threatens to tear a family apart, love, sacrifice, and painful choices test the unbreakable bond between a mother and her children.
items.title: Keevve?

items.overview: One evening, in a classroom, two friends are quietly working. Néo shows Lucas his Halloween mask. Later, while trying to scare his friend with his own mask, Lucas finds himself confronted with a strange transformation.
items.title: The ghost mask

items.overview: As dementia gradually erodes her memory, 60-year-old celebrated theater actor Maya struggles to separate reality from the roles she has performed on stage.
items.title: A Lone Jamun Tree

items.overview: The three crew members of the Gorgonia squadron, aided by advanced AI technology, set out on a routine space mission aboard their ships, "Cetus" and "Forcis"—unaware that this journey will change their lives forever. Gorgonia is more than just a space mission; it is a voyage into the deepest fears of its crew.
items.title: Gorgonia

items.overview: A drama with significant social impact that seeks to bring to light the invisible scars left by violence, and which is part of a nationwide awareness campaign.
items.title: Huellas

items.overview: Jinju, an airport guide facing the loss of her job to a machine, receives unexpected news of a pregnancy and discovers suspicious footage of her husband on a dashcam, then follows the trail it leaves.
items.title: Being Human

items.overview: Sowan can stop time. The catch? Once time stands still, she's the only thing that moves. Not a single person, not even a leaf. Its only use? Gazing at her crush, unnoticed. Sowan, who freezes up in front of the goal, starts one-on-one lessons with her futsal coach, Wooseok.
items.title: DIDIMBAL

items.overview: Young-woo, a motorcycle courier, spends his days racing through the streets of Seoul. Eun-young works as a toll booth attendant at a tollgate cutting through the heart of the city. Longtime lovers, they plan to finish work on December 31 and meet at Namsan to watch the New Year’s celebration together.
items.title: NOWHERE

items.overview: All I inherited from Algeria was a song. A melody my grandfather hummed every day, which turned out to be a trace of the internment of Algerian Jews in the Bedeau camp in Algeria between 1941 and 1943. Blending intimate narrative and historical inquiry, the film follows the thread of this truncated memory and transforms oblivion into a collective story.
items.title: Bedeau, Transit Camp

items.overview: To make a name for herself as the only female performer in the Marrakesh area, Hanane, a young woman from a modest Moroccan village, has raised her own troupe of female riders. The challenges are considerable since fantasia, a festive celebration of equestrian warfare, is a costly and traditionally male-exclusive activity. In the face of social injustices, clashes with her father, cultural pressures, Hanane fights day after day to make her dream come to life. With bulldozers threatening to tear down her village to build luxury suburbs, she knows she has no time to lose. If she wants to save her family and her horses, she needs to gain recognition. She sets upon taking her troupe to the most prestigious moussem in Morocco, where the best riders in the kingdom compete every year.
items.title: Banou

items.overview: A sharp detective investigates a grisly diner massacre, but her mind is consumed by a stolen roasted chicken recipe. Contaminating evidence, she draws bizarre parallels between the victims and her culinary obsession in this surreal noir.
items.title: The Cranberry Effect

items.original_title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story
items.overview: A former YouTube child creator revisits her time on the wildly popular Seven Awesome Kids network to reveal the rise and fall of the online community that brought its members fame - and its owner infamy.
items.title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story

items.overview: Liv just wants to break out of her daily routine for once and go on vacation with her husband Anton and son Basti. But even just before Christmas, Anton can’t make her wish come true. That’s because working at his father Franz’s mountain cabin keeps the whole family tied up around the clocks, 24/7—with no end in sight. And because Anton can’t even manage a small gesture like an Advent calendar, Liv takes a stand and moves in with her friend Sigi. It’s a message Anton understands: with a homemade Advent calendar, he tries to win Liv back—and hides something very special behind the first door.
items.title: 24 Türchen zu dir

items.overview: KIM Young-Chul runs a small liquor store on the outskirts of an American city. Before he dies, he dreams of returning to his hometown in Korea, but the money he has saved over a lifetime is not enough to buy a home in Seoul. Worse, he has lost contact with his son, Steve Kim. One day, Kim Chul-Gi, a church butler, approaches him. An undocumented immigrant, Chul-Gi secretly drives an illegal call taxi and takes on shady jobs for wealthy international students. Behind the scenes, he is planning a fraud involving stolen identities of Korean Americans and foreign students. Meanwhile, Kim Sun-Ho, who came to the United States to obtain a degree and permanent residency, crosses paths with Steve Kim, Young-Chul’s estranged son. Four men become entangled like a Möbius strip, each chasing a different version of the same promise. What does the “American Dream” truly mean for those who live outside it?
items.title: 4Kims

items.overview: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.
items.title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming

items.overview: Quand Janet dort portrays Janet Lumb, a Chinese-Canadian artist who has lived in Montreal for many years. Fuelled by dreams and chaos, her artistic world takes shape through performance and musical composition. At 72, Janet is losing her memory. Her artistic and political legacy, along with the details of her life, are fading, though they remain deeply precious to her friend Laurence. To shake up her daily routine, create new memories and revive old ones, he spontaneously plans a trip to Ecuador. Through a polyphonic narrative moving between spoken and written voices, a memory that spans generations gradually emerges. Together, these voices invite reflection on belonging and what is passed down. Janet’s embodied presence, the archival materials documenting her impact and the tenderness with which she is portrayed celebrate the quiet strength of her work and activism.
items.title: Quand Janet dort

items.overview: Alexei, an elite war android modeled after the youthful image of an aging dictator, serves as commanding officer in a refugee district, leading the suppression of a rebellion. There, he encounters Michael, the last remaining Catholic priest, and awakens to faith—beginning a dangerous journey in search of redemption.
items.title: Raphael

items.overview: A film that centers on a young, lower-middle-class man named Anush. Living in tight, limited housing, Anush plans to keep things simple and spend his honeymoon right at home with his new wife. However, his plans completely unravel on his wedding day when his mother is unexpectedly forced to move into their tiny, single-bedroom apartment.
items.title: Honeymoon Tomorrow

items.overview: When Christmas-averse business executive Jen is reluctantly tasked with looking after her sister’s two kids, handsome neighbor Adam helps her navigate holiday disasters, rediscover family, and open her heart to an unexpected romance this holiday season.
items.title: An Unexpected Christmas Plan

items.overview: A double feature of The Gruffalo and The Gruffalo’s Child
items.title: The Gruffalo: From Father to Son

items.overview: The epic conclusion to the Shane saga arrives. When Marcus Wiley gains the powers of the Red Room and escapes from prison, it's up to Shane to stop his father- once and for all.
items.title: Shane V

items.overview: The second wave of the deadly coronavirus pandemic is raging in the Delhi NCR region. In the midst of this horror, the lives of disparate individuals intertwine, revealing the intricate web of humanity's struggle and strength.
items.title: Delhi 2021

results.overview: After the death of their old college roommate who they haven't spoken to in years, Matt and Milo go to his funeral. Things grow intense as they are expected to give the eulogy.
results.title: Wilting Flowers

results.title: Ayura

results.overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.
results.title: Mustang

results.overview: follows a man who returns to a family farm inherited from his parents, only to uncover a terrifying truth that threatens his survival there. The film explores how family bonds between parents and children can become a source of both salvation and control.
results.title: Soulala

results.overview: Every winter, millions of fir trees are chopped down, admired, and thrown away. The film follows their journey above and below ground, from human rituals to the hidden life inside the trees. A story about trees that we celebrate by cutting them down.
results.title: Holy Wood Dust

results.overview: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.
results.title: Clashing Through the Snow

results.overview: An animated adventure about Jojo the Axolotl, taking on the world to find his family, set in a fantastically inspired Mexican lakeside.
results.title: Axolodyssey

results.overview: This film exposes the hidden dangers of dating apps driven by the urgent consumption of sex and entertainment. Behind simple profile pictures often hide pathological narcissists and ambiguous characters. Looking for fleeting encounters, they prey on vulnerable users through flattery and deception.  In this virtual world, emotional connection is entirely absent. Everyone becomes a mere object of desire in a perverse, addictive game of dominance and submission that detaches users from reality. Ultimately, the virtual realm takes over, leading to a profound depersonalization where human beings are completely stripped of their humanity.
results.title: The Other You

results.overview: Hassan struggles to make a living as a fisherman in a small coastal town, where the sea provides less each year. Isolated by his faith, his only moments of tenderness are with single mother Latifah and her young daughter. When an old friend offers a dangerous alternative, Hassan becomes trapped between judgement and action.
results.title: Waves of Silence

results.overview: Portrait of Mayan midwives who do ultrasounds with their hands, those who respect the nature of the living and that contrast with the modern world.
results.title: Sinahal, The Mayan Midwives

results.overview: The dramatic stories of Iranians living through a year of protests, crackdowns and war. Rare footage and firsthand accounts of the regime's campaign to crush dissent, and of life under U.S. and Israeli bombing.
results.title: Iranians Under Siege

results.original_title: An Angel Messed Up My Christmas
results.overview: When an angel sends Elliot back to high school during Christmas, changing one thing creates a future without the family he loves. Now he must undo his mistakes to save them, and rediscover what made his life perfect all along.
results.title: An Angel Messed Up My Christmas

results.overview: In a world where a deadly virus has made the night air fatal, a secret platform allows people to hire strangers to fulfill their darkest desires.
results.title: The Black Sea

results.overview: In a remote Georgian village surrounded by misty mountains, a local man discovers the body of a young stranger on the riverbank and takes him home to his wife and young son. The arrival of this unexpected guest disturbs the family’s already fragile life, forcing each member to make difficult and extreme decisions.
results.title: Tago

results.overview: Nate Bargatze brings his dry wit and deadpan charm to overzealous parking sensors, the walking politics of marriage and an unhinged family group chat.
results.title: Nate Bargatze: Good for Nathan

results.overview: A quiet get-together among friends ends in a bloody massacre when one of them has the audacity to break a sacred rule of Argentine tradition: the yerba in the mate is never stirred. Never. Ever.
results.title: Mate The 13th

results.overview: Lucía, Juana, and Evaristo work in a city that functions like an open-air factory. Meanwhile, Sami and Claudio work aboard an Argentine space capsule. Following the recent arrival of new owners in the country, Lucía confronts this new order by painting counter-advertisements on city walls. At the same time, Sami tries to return to Earth by any means necessary, after being informed that no one will be coming to look for them.
results.title: O

results.original_title: Memórias de um Assassino de Tigres
results.overview: After being fired from his job, the conformist Aderbal loses all of his unemployment insurance to online betting sites. Devastated by his loss, he embarks on a journey of revenge, vowing to murder every influencer he encounters who promotes gambling websites. Meanwhile, a nuclear conflict between Brazil and the United States threatens all life on Earth.
results.title: Memoirs of a Tiger Killer

results.overview: A mother who is a painter, haunted by the violence of her past, sees her reality begin to crumble after her son returns. As distorted memories and reality blur together, she sinks deeper into a psychological struggle against a trauma that refuses to let her go.
results.title: L’éclat

results.overview: Jax is about to jump off a bridge onto the highway below when he unexpectedly runs into Joy, his childhood friend. Joy tries to calm him down and asks him to stay by his side wherever they go. This unexpected reunion brings them closer again as they spend the entire day together, slowly rekindling their bond.
results.title: Lorazepam

results.overview: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.
results.title: Rob Lowe: The Outsider

results.overview: One dark October evening, 25-year-old Liselotte gets into a car in Timrå. After that, all signs of life cease. Ten days later, she is found dead next to a cliff ledge.
results.title: GW:s mord - Mordet på Liselotte

results.overview: A fictional boy aims to become a non-fictional rapper. His label has other plans.
results.title: SO ALIVE!

results.overview: A collection of portraits from Drobeta-Turnu Severin and its surroundings.
results.title: Fabrica

results.overview: Richie is a man struggling with his inner demons as he faces the effects of substance abuse on both his relationships and mental well-being.
results.title: Sessions

results.overview: On the shore of an island he once imagined, Cassius recalls Sami, his first love and a former tecktonik dancer.
results.title: La Pointe de mon île

results.overview: After tin mining in Singkep ended, Lunar imagines its past grandeur through her mother’s stories. When a mysterious Tin Man appears across fragmented time, merely photographing the present, the film interrogates memory, extraction, and the lingering socio-ecological afterlife of a mined city.
results.title: Portrait of Tin's Family

results.overview: In this enchanting third story in the Home Sweet Christmas franchise, Sophie and Sam embark to celebrate their first anniversary in picturesque Salzburg, a sprawling Christmas postcard town adorned with decorations and lights, a place one can almost smell the scents of mulled wine and gingerbread. What begins as a romantic first-year getaway quickly transforms into a lavish royal mystery when a charismatic hotelier draws the couple into a world of festive surprises. As Sophie uncovers a hidden connection to a beloved Christmas song, she and Sam must navigate the host’s surprising twists to safeguard their love – and to rediscover the true spirit of Christmas.
results.title: A Sweet Christmas Anniversary

results.overview: Follow the unfolding of a catastrophic blizzard that swiftly buried the city of Buffalo in snow and darkness, cutting power, heat, and visibility to residents trapped at home and on roads. A McDonald’s manager breaks protocol to create an impromptu refuge, people instantly mobilize to rescue their neighbors, and a community comes together in the most unexpected Christmas Eve celebration.
results.title: The Buffalo Miracle

results.overview: Bilbao, 1983. Torrential rains cause the river to overflow, flooding the city and plunging it into chaos. Meanwhile, the gay club High remains open, operating intermittently through power cuts as some men continue to come, suspended in a limbo of desire. Little by little, the outside world seeps in: rising water and distant sounds reveal an internal reality from which there is no easy escape.
results.title: High River

results.overview: When Maine wakes up in the middle of the night after a first date, his lover’s house is full of unsettling surprises about who he truly is.
results.title: Lustlings

results.overview: The French-Moroccan Alaoui family is preparing for a holiday reunion in their Marrakech home, eagerly awaiting the arrival of their daughter and sister, Leila. Their fragile balance is shattered when they learn she has been seriously injured while on assignment as a photographer in Burkina Faso. Cut off from her yet determined to bring her home, they struggle against the void her absence threatens to leave behind.
results.title: Leila et la Nuit

results.overview: Podcaster Winona is forced to test love online by a holiday dating-app partnership, connecting with a mystery man who feels like everything she’s been missing. What she doesn’t know is that he’s Luke, the rugged renovator transforming her grandmother’s Christmas Eve venue — and the last guy she’d ever expect to fall for in real life.
results.title: All for Christmas

results.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
results.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.
results.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH

results.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.
results.title: Way of the Warrior Kid

results.original_title: Robert Wilson – Die Schönheit des Geheimnisvollen
results.overview: We look back at more than half a century of mysterious artistic creation while trying to crack a unique artistic code. Why are people moved to tears when Robert “Bob” Wilson puts minimalistic petrol pumps into a production of Shakespeare’s sonnets? Why does merciless repetition change our understanding of something? Together with Tom Waits, Willem Dafoe or Marina Abramović we trace back our own experience of Bob’s art. Is it true what Philipp Glass the collaborator of the milestone piece “Einstein on the Beach” laughingly and with apparent pleasure exclaims “what does it mean? It doesn’t mean anything!”?
results.title: Robert Wilson: The Beauty of the Mysterious

results.overview: Tom is 6 years old. With his camera, he films his mother, the dog, and the alley. Tom has difficulties with studying; he is hyperactive; he has anger issues at school; moreover, he eats crisps for supper. Tom is the son of Nathalie, a loving drug-addicted bipolar mother; the brother of Caroline, an escort who would like to go back to school; and the grandson of Madeleine, the grandmother tired of taking care of everyone. Petit Tom is a film about life and childhood in the setting of chaos, flowing time, family heritage, and motherly love.
results.title: Petit Tom

results.overview: A young boy struggles to put his knowledge to good use. As he faces the choices before him, he must decide whether to use his abilities wisely or let his potential go to waste.
results.title: Acedia

results.overview: Under the ruthless rule of the mighty and evil EL OSO, four subjects secretly plot their revenge, scheming to overthrow the existing regime and seize power for themselves...
results.title: EL OSO

results.overview: The story of Monte Melkonian , National Hero of Armenia, Hero of Artsakh and one of the commanders of the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. Based entirely on real events confirmed by Monte’s widow, Seta Melkonian.
results.title: Monte

results.original_title: Alain Souchon accompagné par Ours & Pierre Souchon
results.title: Alain Souchon accompagné par Ours & Pierre Souchon

results.overview: In a vast darkness, a girl tries to find her way using the only light she can find, one coveted by others.
results.title: Starlight

results.overview: When tragedy threatens to tear a family apart, love, sacrifice, and painful choices test the unbreakable bond between a mother and her children.
results.title: Keevve?

results.overview: One evening, in a classroom, two friends are quietly working. Néo shows Lucas his Halloween mask. Later, while trying to scare his friend with his own mask, Lucas finds himself confronted with a strange transformation.
results.title: The ghost mask

results.overview: As dementia gradually erodes her memory, 60-year-old celebrated theater actor Maya struggles to separate reality from the roles she has performed on stage.
results.title: A Lone Jamun Tree

results.overview: The three crew members of the Gorgonia squadron, aided by advanced AI technology, set out on a routine space mission aboard their ships, "Cetus" and "Forcis"—unaware that this journey will change their lives forever. Gorgonia is more than just a space mission; it is a voyage into the deepest fears of its crew.
results.title: Gorgonia

results.overview: A drama with significant social impact that seeks to bring to light the invisible scars left by violence, and which is part of a nationwide awareness campaign.
results.title: Huellas

results.overview: Jinju, an airport guide facing the loss of her job to a machine, receives unexpected news of a pregnancy and discovers suspicious footage of her husband on a dashcam, then follows the trail it leaves.
results.title: Being Human

results.overview: Sowan can stop time. The catch? Once time stands still, she's the only thing that moves. Not a single person, not even a leaf. Its only use? Gazing at her crush, unnoticed. Sowan, who freezes up in front of the goal, starts one-on-one lessons with her futsal coach, Wooseok.
results.title: DIDIMBAL

results.overview: Young-woo, a motorcycle courier, spends his days racing through the streets of Seoul. Eun-young works as a toll booth attendant at a tollgate cutting through the heart of the city. Longtime lovers, they plan to finish work on December 31 and meet at Namsan to watch the New Year’s celebration together.
results.title: NOWHERE

results.overview: All I inherited from Algeria was a song. A melody my grandfather hummed every day, which turned out to be a trace of the internment of Algerian Jews in the Bedeau camp in Algeria between 1941 and 1943. Blending intimate narrative and historical inquiry, the film follows the thread of this truncated memory and transforms oblivion into a collective story.
results.title: Bedeau, Transit Camp

results.overview: To make a name for herself as the only female performer in the Marrakesh area, Hanane, a young woman from a modest Moroccan village, has raised her own troupe of female riders. The challenges are considerable since fantasia, a festive celebration of equestrian warfare, is a costly and traditionally male-exclusive activity. In the face of social injustices, clashes with her father, cultural pressures, Hanane fights day after day to make her dream come to life. With bulldozers threatening to tear down her village to build luxury suburbs, she knows she has no time to lose. If she wants to save her family and her horses, she needs to gain recognition. She sets upon taking her troupe to the most prestigious moussem in Morocco, where the best riders in the kingdom compete every year.
results.title: Banou

results.overview: A sharp detective investigates a grisly diner massacre, but her mind is consumed by a stolen roasted chicken recipe. Contaminating evidence, she draws bizarre parallels between the victims and her culinary obsession in this surreal noir.
results.title: The Cranberry Effect

results.original_title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story
results.overview: A former YouTube child creator revisits her time on the wildly popular Seven Awesome Kids network to reveal the rise and fall of the online community that brought its members fame - and its owner infamy.
results.title: There Goes My Childhood: The Seven Awesome Kids Story

results.overview: Liv just wants to break out of her daily routine for once and go on vacation with her husband Anton and son Basti. But even just before Christmas, Anton can’t make her wish come true. That’s because working at his father Franz’s mountain cabin keeps the whole family tied up around the clocks, 24/7—with no end in sight. And because Anton can’t even manage a small gesture like an Advent calendar, Liv takes a stand and moves in with her friend Sigi. It’s a message Anton understands: with a homemade Advent calendar, he tries to win Liv back—and hides something very special behind the first door.
results.title: 24 Türchen zu dir

results.overview: KIM Young-Chul runs a small liquor store on the outskirts of an American city. Before he dies, he dreams of returning to his hometown in Korea, but the money he has saved over a lifetime is not enough to buy a home in Seoul. Worse, he has lost contact with his son, Steve Kim. One day, Kim Chul-Gi, a church butler, approaches him. An undocumented immigrant, Chul-Gi secretly drives an illegal call taxi and takes on shady jobs for wealthy international students. Behind the scenes, he is planning a fraud involving stolen identities of Korean Americans and foreign students. Meanwhile, Kim Sun-Ho, who came to the United States to obtain a degree and permanent residency, crosses paths with Steve Kim, Young-Chul’s estranged son. Four men become entangled like a Möbius strip, each chasing a different version of the same promise. What does the “American Dream” truly mean for those who live outside it?
results.title: 4Kims

results.overview: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.
results.title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming

results.overview: Quand Janet dort portrays Janet Lumb, a Chinese-Canadian artist who has lived in Montreal for many years. Fuelled by dreams and chaos, her artistic world takes shape through performance and musical composition. At 72, Janet is losing her memory. Her artistic and political legacy, along with the details of her life, are fading, though they remain deeply precious to her friend Laurence. To shake up her daily routine, create new memories and revive old ones, he spontaneously plans a trip to Ecuador. Through a polyphonic narrative moving between spoken and written voices, a memory that spans generations gradually emerges. Together, these voices invite reflection on belonging and what is passed down. Janet’s embodied presence, the archival materials documenting her impact and the tenderness with which she is portrayed celebrate the quiet strength of her work and activism.
results.title: Quand Janet dort

results.overview: Alexei, an elite war android modeled after the youthful image of an aging dictator, serves as commanding officer in a refugee district, leading the suppression of a rebellion. There, he encounters Michael, the last remaining Catholic priest, and awakens to faith—beginning a dangerous journey in search of redemption.
results.title: Raphael

results.overview: A film that centers on a young, lower-middle-class man named Anush. Living in tight, limited housing, Anush plans to keep things simple and spend his honeymoon right at home with his new wife. However, his plans completely unravel on his wedding day when his mother is unexpectedly forced to move into their tiny, single-bedroom apartment.
results.title: Honeymoon Tomorrow

results.overview: When Christmas-averse business executive Jen is reluctantly tasked with looking after her sister’s two kids, handsome neighbor Adam helps her navigate holiday disasters, rediscover family, and open her heart to an unexpected romance this holiday season.
results.title: An Unexpected Christmas Plan

results.overview: A double feature of The Gruffalo and The Gruffalo’s Child
results.title: The Gruffalo: From Father to Son

results.overview: The epic conclusion to the Shane saga arrives. When Marcus Wiley gains the powers of the Red Room and escapes from prison, it's up to Shane to stop his father- once and for all.
results.title: Shane V

results.overview: The second wave of the deadly coronavirus pandemic is raging in the Delhi NCR region. In the midst of this horror, the lives of disparate individuals intertwine, revealing the intricate web of humanity's struggle and strength.
results.title: Delhi 2021
